title: Count to Five with Sunny! Clap Clap! ⭐
description: Sunny the little star counts to five with claps and jumps. A bouncy way for little ones to practise counting and move along.

beats.line: Boing! Good morning, friends! It's me, Sunny!
Today we count to five. Ready? Clap with me!
Four! Five! Six! Oops, that's too many!
Let's try again. One, two, three, four, five!
Yay! You did it! Great counting, friends!
